description: Builds a verification template (JSON Schema plus cross-field rules and bounds) from 1-10 sample outputs, by fixed rules, no model. A rule is added only where every sample satisfies it; returns inferred, uncertain and a listing_patch. Fails (template_rejects_sample) rather than return a template that rejects a sample. Stores nothing. Free.

required.description: Field paths that must be required in the schema.

unique_fields.description: Array field paths whose values must be unique, e.g. items[].sku.

expectations.description: What samples cannot show: required fields, unique array fields, ranges.

samples.description: 1-10 example outputs as JSON, at most 32 KB in all; varied samples show which fields are optional.

trace_id.description: From a previous response, to continue it; omit on the first call.

name: build_template
title: Build a verification template
